title: Woodshop
tag: A little house. A big welcome.
fact: From a first cutting board to custom furniture, a project starts with an idea.
invitation: Ask a MakeHaven facilitator about getting started in the woodshop.

title: Textiles
fact: Fabric, thread, and a little imagination can become something you wear or share.
invitation: Ask about sewing, embroidery, and the textile tools in the space.

title: Metal shop
fact: Metalworking turns strong materials into useful objects and expressive sculpture.
invitation: Curious about metalworking? Ask a facilitator about tool introductions.

title: Electronics
fact: Circuits can give your projects light, sound, movement, and a way to sense the world.
invitation: Ask about electronics tools and making your first interactive project.

title: Printmaking
fact: Registration lines up each color so separate layers become one finished print.
invitation: Ask about the printmaking tools and how to make a print of your own.

title: BioLab
fact: A microscope reveals patterns and structures that are too small to see unaided.
invitation: Ask what is happening in the community BioLab and how to get involved.
